piece.headline: IB opens with a 78 and Tzolis in the armband
piece.standfirst: IB opens with the best score in the league while 19 managers back Haaland and watch him blank.
piece.big_picture: IB leads after week one. Tzolis paid 12 with the armband, while 19 managers sat behind a Haaland who scored 2. Dominic is 8 points back, Cherag third. It is early, but IB has set the pace and everyone else is chasing.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Will picked the wrong 11 and left 15 points on the bench, the worst in the league. Ayodele left 14. Both will be checking team sheets twice next week.
piece.one_to_watch: The Tin Pot line has Tobi and Simon dead level, with nothing between them. Next week could split them. Further up, IB leads Dominic by 8, and one big armband could close that quickly.

winners.name: IB
winners.verdict: Tzolis as captain returned 12 points with the armband. That's nerve and a good eye, and it earned the top score of the week.

winners.name: Dominic
winners.verdict: Second place, 13 above the average. Left 13 points on the bench, though. Good start, sloppy team sheet.

winners.name: Cherag
winners.verdict: Played Bench Boost and the bench gave nothing. Still third, so the chip was no help but the week was fine.

losers.name: Elvin
losers.verdict: Bottom of the pile with 37, 20 below the average. A rough opener, but it's only week one and there's plenty of road left.

losers.name: Iain
losers.verdict: Left 13 points on the bench, which stings. The score was 16 below the average, but a better team sheet could fix a lot of that.

losers.name: Sasha
losers.verdict: 42 points is a tough opener, 15 below the average. Nothing to be ashamed of this early. Plenty of weeks left to climb.
